newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nippecraft to sell factory buildings.
newsitem.headline: Nippecraft to sell factory buildings.

text.p: Diary maker Nippecraft Ltd said on Thursday it intended to sell its three factories in Singapore.

It said in a statement the three properties were currently being used for the company's manufacturing activities and would be sold with a leaseback agreement to allow it time to obtain alternative premises.
Proceeds from the sale by public tender would be used to repay bank borrowings and to buy smaller premises,it said.
The buildings, with leases to run for another 31 to 46 years, cover a total land area of 13,673 sq metres.
